name: go

tools.install: install Go 1.24 or later from https://go.dev/dl/ (it includes gofmt and go vet)
gofmt comes with Go: install Go from https://go.dev/dl/ and put its bin folder on PATH

checks.name: module
run: out=$(GOWORK=off go mod edit -json) || { printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 1; }; flat=$(printf '%s' "$out" | tr -d ' \t\n'); fail=0; if printf '%s' "$flat" | grep -q '"Ignore":\['; then echo 'go.mod has an ignore directive, which hides folders from ./...'; fail=1; fi; if printf '%s' "$flat" | grep -qE '"New":\{"Path":"([^"\\]|\\.)*"\}'; then echo 'go.mod replaces a module with a folder, whose code the gate does not check'; fail=1; fi; exit $fail

checks.name: format
run: out=$(gofmt -l .) || exit 1; if [ -n "$out" ]; then echo 'not formatted with gofmt:'; echo "$out"; exit 1; fi

checks.name: lint
run: top=$(cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && pwd -P) || exit 1; dir=$(pwd -P); config=; while [ -z "$config" ]; do for name in .golangci.yml .golangci.yaml .golangci.toml .golangci.json; do if [ -f "$dir/$name" ]; then config=$dir/$name; break; fi; done; if [ -n "$config" ] || [ "$dir" = "$top" ] || [ "$dir" = / ]; then break; fi; dir=$(dirname "$dir"); done; if [ -n "$config" ]; then set -- --config "$config"; else set -- --no-config; fi; exec env GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly golangci-lint run "$@" ./...

count_tests: out=$(GOWORK=off GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go test -list . ./... 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 1; }; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -cE '^(Test|Fuzz|Example)[^[:space:]]*$' || true
